value: The third fragment lies within the Arcatraz, a prison in the Tempest Keep complex. Khadgar had hidden it while the naaru held the fortress; by the time the seeker arrives, Kael’thas’s forces have turned the vessel into a place of confinement. The key’s last piece is retrieved from a refuge that has become dangerous. The three fragments can now be taken back to their maker.
